[[Chairman]] & [[Managing Director]]}} | website = {{URL|http://www.vrlgroup.in/}} }} '''VRL Logistics Limited''' (formerly ''Vijayanand Roadlines Ltd.''),{{cite web |title=VRL Logistics Limited: Private Company Information |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=25093798 |website=bloomberg.com |access-date=30 July 2018}} commonly known as the '''VRL Group''', is an Indian [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] [[Headquarters|headquartered]] in [[Hubli|Hubballi]], [[Karnataka]], India with operations in around [[States and union territories of India#States|23 states]] and [[States and union territories of India#Union territories|4 union territories]] in the [[India|country]]. Business operations of ''VRL Group'' include [[road transport]]ation, [[logistics]], [[publishing]], etc. ''VRL Group'' is one of the largest logistics and [[Transport in India|transport]] companies in India (incl.4360 vehicles, comprising 419 [[Tour bus service|tourist buses]] and 3941 transport [[goods]] vehicles). The [[Limca Book of Records]], states it is the single largest [[Fleet vehicle|fleet]] owner of [[commercial vehicle]]s in the [[India|country's]] [[private sector]].{{cite news |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/hublis-transport-tsar-rise-vijay-sankeshwars-vrl-logistics-into-a-nearly-rs-1000-crore-company/articleshow/21036757.cms?from=mdr |title=Hubli's Transport Tsar: Rise Vijay Sankeshwar's VRL Logistics into a nearly Rs 1,000 crore company |newspaper=The Economic Times |date=17 July 2013 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180307214312/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/hublis-transport-tsar-rise-vijay-sankeshwars-vrl-logistics-into-a-nearly-rs-1000-crore-company/articleshow/21036757.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=7 March 2018 |last1=Vaidya |first1=Pramodkumar }} ''VRL's'' [[VRL Group#Media|Vijayavani]]{{cite web|url=http://vijayavani.net/|title=ವಿಜಯವಾಣಿ · ಕನ್ನಡಿಗರ ಧ್ವನಿ|website=ವಿಜಯವಾಣಿ|access-date=17 August 2017|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170813223023/http://vijayavani.net/|archive-date=13 August 2017}} is [[credit]]ed with having the largest [[newspaper circulation]] in Karnataka. ==History== ''VRL Group'' was founded by [[Vijay Sankeshwar]] in 1976 at Gadag, Karnataka, India. His [[family]] [[Ownership|had]] a [[Publication|publication house]], which later became a part of the ''VRL Group''.{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} ==Headquarters and offices== ''VRL'' is [[Headquarters|headquartered]] in [[Hubli|Hubballi]], [[Karnataka]] and has 931 [[Office|branches]], 40 hubs and transport [[yard]]s [[Preposition and postposition|across]] the [[India|country]]. The headquarters has an [[Industrial wastewater treatment|effluent treatment plant]] ([[Capacity of a set|capacity]]:175 [[1000 (number)|thousand]] [[Litre|liters]]), a [[rainwater harvesting]] plant, a [[Filling station|petrol bunk]] (allotted by [[Indian Oil Corporation]]), and a [[Automobile repair shop|garage service]] [[Building#Complex|complex]], where ''VRL’s'' [[truck]]s pass through once in every two [[week]]s.{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} == Services == [[File:VRL-Courier-Services-Office.jpg|thumb|250px|right|''VRL'' [[Courier#India|Courier Services]] near [[Adikavi Pampa|Pampa Mahakavi]] [[road]], [[Chamrajpet]], [[Bengaluru]].{{cite web |title= V.R.L. Couriers Pvt. Ltd. Chamrajpet, Bangalore |url= https://www.sulekha.com/v-r-l-couriers-pvt-ltd-chamrajpet-bangalore-contact-address |publisher= sulekha.com |url-status= live |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20180609072442/https://www.sulekha.com/v-r-l-couriers-pvt-ltd-chamrajpet-bangalore-contact-address |archive-date= 9 June 2018 }}]] === Cargo and Courier === A [[subsidiary]] of ''VRL Group'', '''''VRL General [[Cargo]]''''' started its business service with transportation between Hubballi and Gadag, and later spread across to [[Bengaluru]] and [[Belgaum|Belagavi]]. It has extended into courier services and express cargo, which are now operative in 23 states, handling over 216 [[1,000,000|million]] pieces of cargo/year,{{cite web|url=https://issuu.com/sanjaykumarguptaa/docs/project-on-logistics-management-in-vrl-logistics-/23|title=Project on Logistics management in VRL Logistics|website=ISSUU.com|date=19 May 2012 |access-date=17 August 2017|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160225185651/https://issuu.com/sanjaykumarguptaa/docs/project-on-logistics-management-in-vrl-logistics-/23|archive-date=25 February 2016}} being one of the largest networks in the [[India|country]]. Its courier services are in operation for [[Parcel (package)|parcels]] [[Range (statistics)|ranging]] from small to large [[size]].{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} === Travel === ''VRL's'' public [[Tourism|tour business]] is operated by its division '''''Vijayanand Travels'''''. With more than 80 branches and operated by 1000+ [[Shipping agency|agents]], it is the largest in tour business services in Karnataka and [[Maharashtra]]. It owns 1,550 [[bus]]es (incl. 742 [[Volvo Buses|Volvo buses]] of [[Volvo Buses#Complete buses|9400 XL]] and [[Volvo Buses#Complete buses|9400PX]] [[Multi-axle bus|multi-axle models]]),{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/vrl-logistics-buys-51-volvo-buses-116011501374_1.html|title=VRL Logistics buys 51 Volvo buses|last=IANS|date=15 January 2016|access-date=17 August 2017|via=Business Standard|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170818005436/http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/vrl-logistics-buys-51-volvo-buses-116011501374_1.html|archive-date=18 August 2017}} covering [[States and union territories of India#States|six states]], moving across 350 [[Bus#Tourism|routes]] in the [[India|country]].{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} === Aviation logistics === '''''VRL Logistics Ltd.''''' in 2008, started working in Indian [[Airway (aviation)|Air]] [[Air charter|Chartering]] Industry, operating under the Indian [[Air operator's certificate|Air Operator]] permit (for passenger charter). In the first phase of its business, it owned a [[Beechcraft Premier I]], an [[aircraft]], manufactured by [[Hawker Beechcraft|Hawker Beechcraft Inc]], United States, while in 2013 it purchased another. It offers [[Jet aircraft]] [[Air charter|charters]] to [[Economic sector|sectors]] like [[Business sector|corporate]], [[leisure]] and [[tourism]], special missions, [[event management]], [[Advertising agency|advertisement agencies]] and for [[Air travel|flights]] ([[Very important person|VIP]] [[Categorization|category]]).{{Citation needed|date=May 2022}} === Media === ''VRL Group's'' [[Flagship (broadcasting)|flagship]] entity, '''''[[Vijayavani]]''''' was started on 1 April 2011, which is now the largest [[Newspaper circulation|circulated]] [[List of newspapers in India|newspaper]]{{cite web |author= |date=16 October 2014 |title=ABC verdict- Vijayavani is the leading Kannada daily |url=http://www.exchange4media.com/Print/ABC-verdict--Vijayavani-is-the-leading-Kannada-daily_57826.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150607213639/http://www.exchange4media.com/print/abc-verdict--vijayavani-is-the-leading-kannada-daily_57826.html |archive-date=7 June 2015 |access-date=16 October 2014 |website=exchange4media.com}} in Karnataka. ''VRL Group's'' [[Subsidiary|subsidiary company]] '''''VRL Media Ltd.''''', [[Printing press|prints]] ''Vijayavani'' and is published in 9 cities of the [[Karnataka|state]].{{cite web|url=http://www.vijayavaniadvt.com/|title=VRL Media Ltd – Vijayavani Advertisement (ವಿಜಯವಾಣಿ)|website=Vijayavaniadvt.com|access-date=17 August 2017|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170812104617/http://www.vijayavaniadvt.com/|archive-date=12 August 2017}} ''Vijayavani’s'' [[Editing|lead editor]] of its [[editorial]] division is Chennegowder and Subhash hoogar. Karnataka's second largest circulated newspaper{{citation needed|date=August 2019}} ''[[Vijaya Karnataka]]'', was started by [[Vijay Sankeshwar]] (of ''VRL Group'') in October 2000, and was sold to extract:
VRL Logistics Limited (formerly Vijayanand Roadlines Ltd.), commonly known as the VRL Group, is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Hubballi, Karnataka, India with operations in around 23 states and 4 union territories in the country. Business operations of VRL Group include road transportation, logistics, publishing, etc.
VRL Group is one of the largest logistics and transport companies in India (incl.4360 vehicles, comprising 419 tourist buses and 3941 transport goods vehicles). The Limca Book of Records, states it is the single largest fleet owner of commercial vehicles in the country's private sector.
VRL's Vijayavani is credited with having the largest newspaper circulation in Karnataka.
